jsonFormatter.title: JSON Formatter
jsonFormatter.subtitle: Format, validate, and minify JSON data instantly.

base64.title: Base64 Converter
base64.subtitle: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings instantly with UTF-8 support.
base64.pastePlaceholder: Paste text or Base64 string here...

help.description1: Encode text into Base64 or decode Base64 strings immediately in your browser.
help.description2: Supports URL-safe Base64 and ignores whitespace when needed for robust decoding.
help.description3: All processing is done locally; no data is sent to external servers.

urlEncoder.title: URL Encoder / Decoder
urlEncoder.subtitle: Safely encode or decode special characters and query strings in URLs.

urlEncoder.outputEmpty: Encoded or decoded result appears here.

help.description1: Percent-encode text with encodeURIComponent or encode full URLs while preserving structure.
help.description2: Inspect protocol, host, path, and query parameters when a valid URL is detected.
help.description3: All processing runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

markdown.title: Markdown Preview
markdown.subtitle: Write Markdown and see the rendered result in real time with GitHub Flavored Markdown support.
markdown.previewEmpty: Preview appears here as you type.

help.description1: Live split-pane editing with instant HTML preview powered by GitHub Flavored Markdown.
help.description2: Supports tables, task lists, strikethrough, fenced code blocks, and auto-linked URLs.
help.description3: Your draft is saved locally in the browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

markdown.defaultContent:
## 🚀 Markdown Preview

A real-time previewer with **GitHub Flavored Markdown** support.

### Features

- Real-time conversion ⚡️
- Table support
- Auto-link generation

### Code example

```javascript
const greeting = "Hello, Sparky!";
console.log(greeting);
```

### Checklist

- [x] GFM enabled
- [ ] Syntax highlighting — coming soon
- [ ] Export feature

epochConverter.title: Unix Time Converter
epochConverter.subtitle: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back, with a live clock and local/UTC output.
epochConverter.toDateSubtitle: Enter a Unix timestamp to convert it to a date and time.
epochConverter.toDateEmptyState: Enter a Unix timestamp above to see the converted date.
epochConverter.toTimestampSubtitle: Set a date and time to convert it to a Unix timestamp.

help.description1: Unix time counts the seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970 (the Unix Epoch).
help.description2: 10-digit numbers are treated as seconds and 13-digit numbers as milliseconds — the unit is detected automatically.
help.description3: All processing runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

userAgent.title: User-Agent Parser
userAgent.subtitle: Parse a User-Agent string to identify the browser, operating system, device type, and rendering engine.
userAgent.emptyState: Paste a User-Agent string above, or use your own browser's string, to see the parsed result.

help.description1: User-Agent strings can be spoofed, so they should never be relied on for security decisions.
help.description2: Most User-Agent strings still start with "Mozilla/5.0" for historical compatibility reasons.
help.description3: All parsing runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

sqlFormatter.title: SQL Formatter
sqlFormatter.subtitle: Format messy SQL queries into a readable, consistently indented form.
sqlFormatter.invalidInput: Could not format this query. Check for syntax errors.

help.description1: Supports Standard SQL as well as MySQL, PostgreSQL, T-SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery and other common dialects.
help.description2: Adjust indent size, tabs vs. spaces, and keyword/identifier casing to match your team's style.
help.description3: All formatting runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

qrGenerator.title: QR Code Generator
qrGenerator.subtitle: Convert URLs or text into scannable QR codes and download them as PNG.
qrGenerator.emptyState: Enter text above to generate a QR code.

regexTester.title: Regex Tester
regexTester.subtitle: Test regular expressions against sample text in real time, with match highlighting, capture groups, and code snippets.
regexTester.testStringPlaceholder: Enter text to test against your pattern...
regexTester.replacementPlaceholder: Use $1, $2 to refer to capture groups...
regexTester.resultEmpty: The replacement result will appear here.
regexTester.emptyState: Enter a pattern and a test string above to see match results.

help.description1: Matching uses the JavaScript RegExp engine, the same one running in your browser.
help.description2: Turn off the Global flag to test .exec()-style single-match behavior instead of finding every match.
help.description3: All matching runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

jwtDecoder.title: JWT Decoder
jwtDecoder.subtitle: Decode and inspect the Header, Payload, and Signature of any JSON Web Token instantly.
jwtDecoder.signatureNote: Signature verification requires the secret key and is not performed here.
jwtDecoder.emptyState: Paste a JWT token above to inspect its contents.
